xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for GitHub issue #2302 (P3 papercuts split from #2295). Leaf-implementation slice built on origin/master, swarm-cohort with #2301.

plan.title: triage:welcome papercuts -- layout-aware not-found warnings, cache passthrough guard, help text

narratives.Description: Fix the grouped triage-onboarding papercuts from #2302. Item 1 (layout-aware not-found path): the `policy:show` warning and the vbrief-build project-definition loader build the PROJECT-DEFINITION path from the hardcoded `vbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.vbrief.json` constant instead of the layout-aware resolver, so an xbrief-layout project sees a misleading `vbrief/` path in a not-found warning even though the typed value resolves fine. Route both through the layout-aware `projectDefinitionPath` / `resolveProjectDefinitionPath` so the message reflects the resolved layout (xbrief vs vbrief). Item 2 (cache:fetch-all passthrough): reproduce the go-task arg passthrough; verified NOT reproducible on master (flag order + values preserved across space/equals/reversed forms via `task --dry`), so add a deterministic regression guard for the engine:invoke era instead of fabricating a fix. Item 3 (help text for --onboard/--preset/--wip-cap) is coupled to PR #2300 (still open; owns packages/cli/src/triage-welcome.ts and adds --preset/--wip-cap) and is deferred to avoid fabricating non-existent flags and conflicting with #2300.
narratives.Overview: P3 low-severity papercuts split from #2295 while shipping the P1 fix (PR #2300). Each item independently shippable. This slice ships items 1 and 2 on origin/master; item 3 defers to PR #2300 (which owns the CLI flags it must document).
narratives.UserStory: As an operator on an xbrief-layout project, I want triage/policy not-found warnings to name the actually-resolved PROJECT-DEFINITION path (xbrief, not vbrief) so the signal is not confusing; and I want the `task cache:fetch-all` arg passthrough to be regression-guarded so recovery flags are never silently dropped or reordered.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Item 1a: in packages/cli/src/policy.ts::runShow, replace `join(projectRoot, PROJECT_DEFINITION_REL_PATH)` with the layout-aware `projectDefinitionPath(projectRoot)` (already exported from @deftai/directive-core/policy); drop the now-unused `PROJECT_DEFINITION_REL_PATH` and `join` imports. 2. Item 1b: in packages/core/src/vbrief-build/project-definition-io.ts, make `projectDefinitionPath` layout-aware via `resolveProjectDefinitionPath(resolve(projectRoot))` (aligns with the already-layout-aware mutation lock), and drop the unused hardcoded-constant import. 3. Item 1c: remove the unused hardcoded `PROJECT_DEFINITION_REL_PATH` export from packages/core/src/triage/welcome/constants.ts (dead latent trap named by the issue). 4. Item 2: add a deterministic regression test asserting every {{.CLI_ARGS}}-forwarding task in tasks/cache.yml declares no `sources:`/`generates:` and no double-quoted CLI_ARGS (closes the guard gap the existing uv-run-python-only caching test leaves after the engine:invoke migration). 5. Tests: extend packages/cli/src/policy.test.ts (xbrief-layout not-found warning names the xbrief path) and packages/core/src/vbrief-build/project-definition-io.test.ts (projectDefinitionPath resolves xbrief on a migrated tree, vbrief otherwise). 6. Run `TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d) task check`; add a CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry (Refs #2295, #2302).

items.title: Given an xbrief-layout project with no PROJECT-DEFINITION, when a not-found warning is emitted (policy:show, vbrief-build loader), then the message names the resolved xbrief path, not the hardcoded vbrief path.

narrative.Acceptance: Given an xbrief-layout project with no PROJECT-DEFINITION, when a not-found warning is emitted (policy:show, vbrief-build loader), then the message names the resolved xbrief path, not the hardcoded vbrief path; a vbrief-layout project is unchanged (fallback).
